title: Separate Sign Up and Log In buttons on the authentication screen

requirements.summary: Update the unauthenticated LoginScreen to display two distinct primary actions: “Sign Up” and “Log In”, replacing the single combined CTA while keeping the existing Internet Identity flow.
acceptanceCriteria: On the LoginScreen, two separate buttons are visible: "Sign Up" and "Log In".
The previous combined button label "Sign Up / Log In" is no longer shown.
Both buttons initiate the existing Internet Identity authentication flow (no backend changes required).

file_operations.description: Replace the single "Sign Up / Log In" CTA with two distinct shadcn-ui Button components labeled "Sign Up" and "Log In", each triggering the existing `login()` action from `useInternetIdentity` (no auth mechanism changes). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure correct disabled/loading behavior during authentication: clicking either CTA disables both buttons while logging in and shows clear “Connecting…” feedback in the auth CTA area.
acceptanceCriteria: While `loginStatus === 'logging-in'`, both buttons are disabled to prevent duplicate login attempts.
During the logging-in state, the UI shows a "Connecting..." loading state (spinner + text) on the auth CTA area.
When login completes or errors, buttons return to enabled state accordingly.

file_operations.description: Use `loginStatus` from `useInternetIdentity` to (1) disable both "Sign Up" and "Log In" buttons when `loginStatus === 'logging-in'`, and (2) render a clear CTA-area loading state (e.g., lucide-react Loader2 + "Connecting...") during the logging-in state while ensuring normal button content returns after success/error. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
